'''Jermac''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Portmoak sector/Legends|Portmoak sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Located along the [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]], Jermac was a notable [[Spice/Legends|spice]] producer.<ref name="TEA" />
